# GitHub Copilot Instructions for waveform-navigator

All contributor and AI-assistant guidance for this repository lives in
[`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. **Read that file.**

It is the single source of truth for:

- what this package is and its public-API constraints
- the command set (build, type-check, lint, format, unit tests, e2e, visual)
- architecture, data flow, and the invariants to preserve before editing
- the enforced rule that public-API changes must update `README.md` and `demo/src/`
- testing layout and coverage thresholds
- code style (Prettier/ESLint settings)
- git, CI, and the commit-message conventions that drive releases

This file deliberately carries no guidance of its own, so there is nothing here
to fall out of date. Do not add instructions here — add them to `CLAUDE.md`.
